page: Google Cloud Platform a4x-highgpu-4g is an accelerator-optimized server instance designed for heavy computational workloads. It features 140 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 CPU architecture, paired with 884.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 6.31 GB of RAM per core.

The primary acceleration capability of this instance is delivered by four NVIDIA GB200 GPUs from the Blackwell family. These GPUs provide a combined total of 744 GB of VRAM, making the instance capable of handling large-scale parallel processing tasks.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, as the local storage size is designated as none. Additionally, it does not provide any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. These factors require users to configure external block storage and network routing separately.

Given the high density of GPU resources and dedicated arm64 processing cores, this instance is designed for workloads such as large language model training, complex machine learning inference, and high-performance data science jobs. The hardware profile represents a high-density resource allocation where cost efficiency is realized through the consolidation of massive GPU memory and parallel compute capacity.
